title: The Barley Pillow Waiting by the Lamp
youtube_title: The Barley Pillow Waiting by the Lamp | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness can finish its quiet work before anyone has to ask.
summary: While Grandpa names stars outside, Esther warms his barley pillow, turns his slippers toward the door, and pours his milk so the room feels looked after.
